decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings draw directly on the firm's core housing and drainage engineering know-how, so it can keep interpreting market feedback and refining the line.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's central competence and fits its move toward low-profile, accessible bathrooms, giving it the strongest capacity to improve this line.

The shower element with integrated slope builds on the firm's floor-level and waterproofing knowledge and supports its integrated-system direction, though it lies somewhat further from its metal fabrication base.
The backflow-protected basement drain applies the firm's established drainage and sealing expertise to a related segment where its engineering knowledge lets it assimilate and act on results.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with weaker ties to the core design-drain knowledge, but it rounds out the system offer at low cost, so it stays for now despite elevated risk.
